title: Coefficient equivalence transports the ordinary relative derived tensor
statement: Let l be prime and Y any scheme in the project universes. Let A be the native coefficient-module category AdicSheaf l Y and B the condensed coefficient-module category over condensedRingObj(padicAlgClRingObj l,Y), as in [lem-sf-weil-verdier-module-constructibility-comparison]. Let H be a bifunctor D(A)^op times D(A) to D(A), let R be its ordinary product-total Hom representative model, and let S be a closed monoidal structure for H with symmetry beta. Assume NativeOrdinaryTensorModels l Y H R S beta from [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models]: S tensor is computed by the actual ordinary relative total tensor on K-flat representatives with the specified componentwise adjunction and Koszul symmetry. Put F=(AdicSheaf.forgetAb l Y followed by comap along nativeModuleCoefficientIso l Y).mapDerivedCategory. For every P in D(A), the functors tensorRight_S(P) followed by F and F followed by CondensedRing.derivedTensor(padicAlgClRingObj l,Y).obj(FP) are naturally isomorphic. The latter fixes FP on the left. No Frobenius structure, derived-Hom comparison, boundedness or constructibility hypothesis is asserted.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-native-ordinary-tensor-identification] to identify tensorRight_S(P) with the standard native derived tensorRight(P). Its proof compares the natural Hom representatives and uses uniqueness of adjoints; no arbitrary extra tensor data are chosen.

Use the ordinary monoidal structure of [lem-sf-native-scalar-forgetting-monoidal] on ambient scalar forgetting. Restriction along the coefficient isomorphism [lem-sf-locally-finite-coefficient-ring-realization] is strong monoidal by [def-sfb-comap-iso-strong-monoidal]. Both functors are equivalences, using [lem-sf-native-scalar-forgetting-equivalence] for forgetting. Their composite E is an exact additive monoidal equivalence and preserves flat objects.

The existing proved generic Functor.mapDerivedCategoryTensorComparison for an additive monoidal flat-preserving exact functor is invertible. Its construction compares the total tensors on K-flat resolutions and localizes, for the standard derived tensors [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Evaluate it at P and compose with the native tensor identification. First use the canonical derived braiding to change tensorRight(P) to tensorLeft(P), matching the target functor which fixes F(P) on the left.

theorem nativeCoefficient_tensorComparison (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (H : (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))ᵒᵖ ×
      DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))
    (R : NativeHomRepresentatives (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l Y) H)
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure H)
    (β : @SymmetricCategory _ _ S.monoidal)
    (_hModels : NativeOrdinaryTensorModels l Y H R S β) :
    let F := (ProEtale.AdicSheaf.forgetAb l Y ⋙
      Mod.comap (ProEtale.nativeModuleCoefficientIso l Y).hom).mapDerivedCategory
    ∀ P : DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y),
      Nonempty (@MonoidalCategory.tensorRight _ _ S.monoidal P ⋙ F ≅
        F ⋙ (ProEtale.CondensedRing.derivedTensor
          (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l) Y).obj (F.obj P))
